<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Try ACTION7 to reset
result = action(['ACTION7'])
print("After ACTION7:", result.get('board_changed'), result.get('gameplay_changed'))
print("Level completed:", result.get('level_completed'))

seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'c':
        b = n['boundary']
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"  Dark gray: pixels={n['pixels']} cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check dot colors
print("\nDot colors:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 1:
        b = n['boundary'][0]
        if b[1] == 28:
            print(f"  divider dot: color={n['color']}")
            break
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 1:
        b = n['boundary'][0]
        if 45 <= b[1] <= 59:
            print(f"  character dot: color={n['color']}")
            break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
